status: candidate-only; no production code, config, or existing file was modified
purpose: Full-prompt rewrites of the Grammar, Ask and Coach prompts, banked for blind A/B comparison against the live production prompts.

baseline.note: SHA-256 of the exact strings used at runtime (template literals normalize CRLF to LF); the first 16 hex chars match the A/B harness manifest.

files.hash-note: sha256 is the raw file bytes; abManifestPrefix is the harness value (SHA-256 of the LF-normalized, trimmed text, first 16 hex chars) as printed by npm run ab:run.

strategy.json.purpose: Optional one-line delta instructions in variants.json shape, for the root generate.mjs harness. NOT a substitute for the full rewrites.

assembly.grammar: analyzeGrammar joins [systemPrompt, inputScope] with a blank line. system.txt is self-contained and remains consistent with the production INPUT_SCOPE, so it can also be tested alone (root harness). inputScope.txt is the optimized companion for scripts/prompt-ab.
assembly.ask: askStateless replaces {{history}}, then appends ASK_METADATA_PROMPT, askLanguagePrompt(language) and the no-table formatting rule. Those fragments stay production-fixed; ask.txt must not restate their values.
assembly.coach: generateCoachReport prepends languageInstruction and appends outputRequirements. system.txt must not set the report language or relax the five-section / eight-subsection / citation validator.

contracts-preserved: Grammar: raw JSON with exactly correction, refine, evaluate, diagnoses, remember; non-empty refine; empty correction when clean; complete corrected passage; severity Minor/Moderate/Major; taxonomy unchanged.
Ask: {{history}} placeholder retained; six required JSON fields; Simplified Chinese title; tags/category from the supplied vocabularies; no markdown tables; explicit response language wins.
Coach: exactly ## 1.-## 5. headings, ### 4.1.-### 4.8. subsections, at least one valid [S#] citation, no invented ids, no study plan, no pipeline statistics in section 2, Markdown only.

mirrors.scripts: scripts/prompt-ab/variants/{grammar,ask,coach}/optimized/ (byte-identical copies for npm run ab:run; no harness code changed)

ab-commands.root-harness: copy the three strings from strategy.json into prompt-ab/variants.json (or merge as an optimized key in candidates.json), then: node .\generate.mjs --ollama --candidate optimized --split formal --pilot

out-of-scope: lib/features/learning-diagnosis/coach-prompt.mjs COACH_PROMPT (separate JSON-schema diagnostic path, not the report generator targeted by both A/B harnesses)
Prompts.AskCompactPrompt and the other config prompt templates
